create_matrix_factorization_privatizer: create a gradient privatizer that adds correlated Gaussian noise to gradients using a noising matrix
create_gaussian_privatizer: create a gradient privatizer that adds isotropic Gaussian noise to clipped aggregated gradients
create_streaming_matrix_privatizer: create a gradient privatizer from a StreamingMatrix for memory-efficient correlated noise generation
use_supported_strategies: use SupportedStrategies DEFAULT or ZERO to configure noise shape and sharding for single or multi-machine training
compose_privatizer_with_optimizer: compose a privatizer with an optimizer via optax.chain to apply differentially private gradient updates
